Eye Pattern - Horizontal Pupils.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Horizontal Pupils
Wide, horizontal slit pupils like a goat's — a rare, unsettling look that reads as alien or herbivore-adapted.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Horizontal Pupils.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Both eyes have horizontal rectangular pupils, giving the eyes an unsettling wide-set appearance within the colored irises. Apply horizontal rectangular pupils to both eyes using selected eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
